en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard featuring an ornate archway with symmetrical potted trees and topiaries. The arch is intricately decorated, with Swedish text above the arches reading 'MALMÖHUS LÄN' and 'MALMÖ STAD'. The interior wall includes a large mural or map and a heraldic crest. The architectural details and design suggest a historical public or exhibition building.
